steps.name: ImportModel
steps.label: Import Model
steps.min_scenario: You dig through the project/library folders by hand to find the latest published version, confirm it's the right one, and bring it in — when the folders are tidy and it's where it should be.
steps.max_scenario: The published version isn't where it should be, is the wrong one, or was never published — you Slack/email whoever touched it last, wait, maybe walk the building, and the task stalls for days.

steps.name: CheckForReviewFiles
steps.label: Check For Review Files
steps.goal:
Locate the render image sequence to review (prefers ``playblast``) and
stash its printf pattern + frame range in shared_data for downstream steps.
steps.min_scenario: You set up the camera/settings and capture the media by hand, then drop it where reviewers look — when it works first try.
steps.max_scenario: Settings are off or reviewers can't find it; you re-capture and re-share, and review slips.

steps.name: CheckForExistingReview
steps.label: Check For Existing Review
steps.goal:
Clear any stale preview so this run regenerates clean media, and note
whether a tracker Version already exists for this context.
steps.min_scenario: You set up the camera/settings and capture the media by hand, then drop it where reviewers look — when it works first try.
steps.max_scenario: Settings are off or reviewers can't find it; you re-capture and re-share, and review slips.

steps.name: AddDescription
steps.label: Add Description
steps.goal:
Ensure a version description is set.

Headless/farm-safe: the description comes from shared_data (set by the
trigger / UI before the recipe runs); we don't pop a dialog here. Falls
back to a sensible default so the review never blocks.
steps.min_scenario: You set up the camera/settings and capture the media by hand, then drop it where reviewers look — when it works first try.
steps.max_scenario: Settings are off or reviewers can't find it; you re-capture and re-share, and review slips.

steps.name: CreateJpgProxies
steps.label: Create Proxies
steps.goal:
Normalize the review sequence to standardized HD PNG proxies.

The standard intermediate (handles EXR → predictable HD PNG) downstream
media + the in-app player consume. Delegates to ``services/media/video``.
steps.min_scenario: You set up the camera/settings and capture the media by hand, then drop it where reviewers look — when it works first try.
steps.max_scenario: Settings are off or reviewers can't find it; you re-capture and re-share, and review slips.

steps.name: CreateReviewMedia
steps.label: Create Review Media
steps.goal:
Encode the HD proxies to the review mp4 at the version's preview path
(``.preview/preview.mp4`` — the mp4-currency convention). Delegates to
``services/media/video.sequence_to_mp4``.
steps.min_scenario: You set up the camera/settings and capture the media by hand, then drop it where reviewers look — when it works first try.
steps.max_scenario: Settings are off or reviewers can't find it; you re-capture and re-share, and review slips.

steps.name: CreateSgVersion
steps.label: Create Sg Version
steps.goal:
Create a review Version in the active tracker (ShotGrid/…) via the
backend-agnostic tracking layer. Ensures project/asset/task context first.
Clean no-op when no tracker is configured.
steps.min_scenario: You set up the camera/settings and capture the media by hand, then drop it where reviewers look — when it works first try.
steps.max_scenario: Settings are off or reviewers can't find it; you re-capture and re-share, and review slips.

steps.name: GenerateThumbnails
steps.label: Generate Thumbnails
steps.goal:
Generate version + task thumbnails from the review proxies.

Delegates to ``services/media/video.thumbnail`` (middle frame).
steps.min_scenario: You set up the camera/settings and capture the media by hand, then drop it where reviewers look — when it works first try.
steps.max_scenario: Settings are off or reviewers can't find it; you re-capture and re-share, and review slips.

steps.name: UploadToShotgrid
steps.label: Upload To Shotgrid
steps.goal:
Attach the review mp4 to the tracker Version (uploads + adds to today's
dailies). Backend-agnostic via the tracking layer; no-op without a tracker.
steps.min_scenario: You set up the camera/settings and capture the media by hand, then drop it where reviewers look — when it works first try.
steps.max_scenario: Settings are off or reviewers can't find it; you re-capture and re-share, and review slips.

steps.name: MarkForReview
steps.label: Mark for Review
steps.goal: mark the mp4 file we've created in this task for review within Alchemy.
steps.pass_criteria: new tab is opened showing the review in the media link.

steps.name: AddToDailiesPlaylist
steps.label: Add To Dailies Playlist
steps.goal: Ensure a Dailies playlist for the current task exists for today's date, ("Model Dailies 8-1-2026") and add the review(s) to the playlist.
steps.fail_criteria: No media added to playlist, or playlist not created

steps.name: ExportRig
steps.label: Export Rig
steps.goal:
Automated rig export phase. 
Encapsulates the extraction of the rig hierarchy into a versioned .ma file.
steps.min_scenario: You hand-export the file(s) to the right place in the right format(s), double-checking the path — when you remember every format and where it goes.
steps.max_scenario: A format's missing, the path's wrong, or settings are off; downstream can't find or use it, pings you, and you re-export — days of back-and-forth.

steps.name: AddDescription
steps.label: Add Description
steps.min_scenario: Someone hand-enters the notes/metadata for the records — quick when they bother.
steps.max_scenario: It's left blank; downstream has no context for what changed and has to ask around or guess.

steps.name: Publish
steps.label: Publish
steps.goal: This function publishes a Maya scene and passes a check for completion.
steps.min_scenario: You manually copy the version to the publish/latest location and a coordinator hand-updates the tracker and pings downstream — when everyone actually does their part.
steps.max_scenario: The coordinator's slammed and forgets (or no one notifies downstream); everyone waiting burns days on Slack, text, email, phone, and walking the building to find out if it's ready.

msd_path = this is the path to the msd file for the current task.  ie: if you're working on the mld task, this will be the path to the mld msd file.
task = this is the name of the task.  ie: 'mld', 'rig', 'anm'
task_object = the task object allows you to work in context of the task. ie: if you are working on the mld task, it will allow you to get the latest mld publish, or the latest mld msd file.
dcc = this is the dcc we are working in.  ie: 'maya', 'houdini', 'nuke'
